external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The Fab Lab offers technical prototyping facilities for innovation, invention and learning and is aimed at making 3D design and manufacturing available to the community. In addition to this, the Fab Lab operates a computer aided crafting & design course which offers the opportunity to participants to avail of third level education places in Carlow IT and Waterford IT upon completion of the course.
